title: ChatGPT Web to RDC is external observation until it enters the Harness gateway
summary: Local Harness planner/worker work has authoritative correlation, while ChatGPT Web calls made directly through Remote Desktop Commander remain post-hoc external observations without trustworthy turn/message parentage.
claims: Do not synthesize correlation for RDC rows from timestamp proximity.
Harness-owned work already carries correlation through local model and worker actors.
The primary remaining provenance gap is pre-dispatch ChatGPT turn/tool identity for external RDC/MCP calls.
decision: Move ChatGPT external tool dispatch behind GW-01 rather than heuristically decorating completed RDC history.
rationale: Correlation is causal baggage allocated before work starts, not a visualization label inferred afterward.
